name: Technical Writing Fundamentals & Craft
description: Core writing and editing principles for technical communication: clarity, conciseness, active voice, audience-first framing, style guide adherence (Google/Microsoft), minimalism, readability metrics, and terminology management.

subskills.name: Clarity, Conciseness & Active Voice
subskills.description: Writing with active voice, direct sentence structures, strong verbs, and eliminating jargon, filler words, and nominalizations.

subskills.name: Technical Style Guides & Standards
subskills.description: Adherence and application of major tech style guides such as Google Developer Documentation Style Guide, Microsoft Writing Style Guide, and Chicago Manual of Style.

subskills.name: Audience & Developer Persona Analysis
subskills.description: Analyzing audience technical proficiency, mental models, job-to-be-done (JTBD), and tailoring vocabulary, depth, and pacing to developers, admins, or end-users.

subskills.name: Information Architecture & Document Hierarchy
subskills.description: Structuring complex technical documents using semantic heading hierarchies, progressive disclosure, chunking, breadcrumbs, and scannable layouts.

subskills.name: Topic-Based Authoring & DITA Paradigms
subskills.description: Topic-based authoring paradigms (Concept, Task, Reference, Troubleshooting) separating procedural instructions from conceptual explanations and reference data.

subskills.name: Terminology, Taxonomy & Glossary Governance
subskills.description: Creating and governing consistent product taxonomies, controlled vocabularies, enterprise glossaries, and deprecated term tracking.

subskills.name: Readability Scoring & Substantive Editing
subskills.description: Applying formal readability formulas (Flesch-Kincaid, Gunning Fog, Coleman-Liau) and editorial tiers (copyediting, developmental editing, substantive editing).

subskills.name: Inclusive, Accessible & Global English
subskills.description: Implementing global English, accessible technical writing (WCAG 2.1 text alternatives, color-agnostic directions), gender-neutral phrasing, and localization-friendly writing.

subskills.name: Documentation Governance & Style Creation
subskills.description: Designing organizational style guides, writing tenets, editorial governance workflows, and automated style linting rules (Vale rule definitions).

junior.description: Writes clear, concise, active-voice documentation adhering to established Google/Microsoft style guides and basic persona needs.

mid.description: Structures multi-page documentation with topic-based authoring (DITA), manages controlled glossaries, and designs scannable information architectures.

senior.description: Establishes enterprise documentation governance, authors custom Vale linting rules, leads editorial reviews, and enforces global WCAG accessibility standards.
